hints.tr: Önce bilinmeyen ürünü yakala: `if product not in stock:`. Ondan sonra `stock[product]`'a güvenle bakabilirsin.
hints.en: Catch the unknown product first: `if product not in stock:`. After that you can safely look at `stock[product]`.

hints.tr: `elif stock[product] >= amount:` → stoktan düş; `else:` → `missing = amount - stock[product]`, `shortages[product] = missing`.
